RTRMH Senior Resident Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for RTRMH Senior Resident Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the RTRMH Senior Resident recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the RTRMH Senior Resident recruitment is scheduled for 07 August 2026. Candidates should attend the interview on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies for Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 27 vacancies announced for the Senior Resident posts at Rao Tula Ram Memorial Hospital.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Senior Resident post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Post Graduate Degree (MD/DNB/DIPLOMA or equivalent) or MBBS with at least 2 years of experience in the relevant specialty, with 1 year in a government hospital.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Senior Resident position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Senior Resident post is 45 years. Age relaxation is applicable for reserved categories as per rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Senior Resident post?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a salary of Rs. 67,700 per month, plus allowances as per the 7th CPC Pay Matrix Level 11.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for the RTRMH Senior Resident positions?
faq.answer: The application process is through a Walk-in Interview. Interested and eligible candidates need to attend the interview on the specified date with all required documents.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, self-attested photocopies, recent passport-size photographs, and a duly filled application form if required.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the walk-in interview scheduled to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at Rao Tula Ram Memorial Hospital, New Delhi - 110073.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for the Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Senior Resident posts at RTRMH will be based on an Interview.
